from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 09:32 2020 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 16 - 19 July 2020 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Aston Martin Red Bull Racing team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eight hour period which commenced at 01:00 on 18 July, eleven hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 09:00 on 18 July. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Aston Martin Red Bull Racing team during the 2020 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
